chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 361 – Youth-Accelerating Pill, Refining Disaster, and the Ancient Array
chapter_meta_description: Han Li trades the Youth-Accelerating Pill for rare tools, suffers a brutal refining loss, and receives Xin Ruyin’s parting gift: the ancient teleportation array blueprints.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 361 – The Price of Beauty, the Cost of Refining
og_description: Han Li exploits a vanity weakness, watches precious materials turn to ash, and secures an escape route with a vow of vengeance. A classic Mortal Stream chapter.
twitter_title: RMJI 361 – Youth Pills, Burning Materials, and a Cold Promise
twitter_description: Han Li trades a vanity pill for rare tools, loses most of his demon-beast materials to a failed refiner, and takes a vow of future vengeance. Classic grind.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary pill that permanently halts the aging process, granting eternal youth to the user. In the Mortal Stream, its value lies not in power but in psychological leverage—it is a currency that cuts across gender and status.
A set of rare flying needles exchanged by Han Li for the Youth-Accelerating Pills; their value and rarity are noted by the Star Dust Pavilion’s managers.
A high-end trading establishment within the market town, known for stocking rare magical tools and pill formulas; its female managers proved especially susceptible to the lure of eternal beauty.

A long-lost form of spatial transportation, far beyond the capabilities of modern refiners. Xin Ruyin’s successful restoration is a rare technical feat and provides Han Li with a tactical escape route from the Yue Kingdom.
A local cultivator gathering site where rogue cultivators and clan disciples exchange gossip and trade; a low-stakes intelligence hub for Foundation Establishment cultivators.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li forgive Old Xu so easily?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Making an enemy of a local refiner over destroyed materials is worse than accepting a loss. Han Li files the lesson, keeps the relationship usable, and moves on.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Fu Clan vow a major plot hook?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes. This is a classic Mortal Stream promise—open-ended, conditional on power, and intended to be collected coldly when the time is right. The seed is planted now.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Will the ancient teleportation array save him?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a tactical exit option, not a guaranteed escape. In the Mortal Stream, no single route is safe; Han Li is building options, not certainties.
